name: Tidelock
summary: An opponent vanishes for three turns; then the d12 decides whether it returns.

face.name: Tidelock

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Choose an opposing Entity and put it into its owner's Retire Zone for 3 turns. At the end of its third turn, its controller rolls a d12: on 8 or more the Entity returns to their Front; otherwise it goes to the Abyss.

face.flavor: The tide closes. Whoever is inside waits.
